definitions: A surname from Spanish [in turn from Galician].
A town in Panama, formerly in the Panama Canal Zone.

blocks.text: The Balboa 16 is an American trailerable sailboat that was designed by W. Shad Turner as a day sailer and first built in 1981.
The Balboa 20 is an American trailerable sailboat that was designed by Lyle C. Hess as a cruiser, at the request of Richard Arthur and first built in 1967.
